entry_rules.CALL: Uptrend (7+ candles above EMA 20) -> pullback to EMA 20 or lower BB -> bounce up + RSI/Stoch confirm
entry_rules.PUT: Downtrend (7+ candles below EMA 20) -> pullback to EMA 20 or upper BB -> reject down + RSI/Stoch confirm
